北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny at 4℃, feels like 1℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪 14℃ 阳光正好，微风不燥，适合出门散步，享受好天气。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and pleasant at 14℃. Enjoy the beautiful day!

上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 13℃，阳光和煦，微风轻拂。体感舒适，记得多喝水哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 13℃ and sunny. A comfortable day, remember to hydrate!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 23℃ 暖暖的，多云天气，穿件舒适的衣服就好啦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm at 23℃. Dress comfortably!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 22℃ 多云，空气有些湿润。出门记得带伞，以防万一。

杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 14℃ 阳光明媚，体感舒适。别忘了出门走走，享受好时光。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and 14℃. A perfect day to go for a walk!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京 14℃，天气晴朗，体感温和。外出游玩，心情也会很棒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and mild at 14℃. Enjoy your time outdoors!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 13℃ 多云，微风拂面。这样的天气，出门散散心很不错。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 13℃ with a light breeze. Enjoy your day!

武汉.name: 武汉

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 11℃，晴朗干燥，记得多喝水。早晚温差大，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 11℃, dry. Hydrate well and mind the temperature change!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 12℃ 阴天，空气湿润。体感稍凉，出门别忘添件外套。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 12℃ with high humidity. Bring a jacket!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -19℃，体感极寒！请务必全副武装，注意防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -19℃, feels freezing! Bundle up and stay very warm!

昆明.name: 昆明

昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 16℃. Enjoy the sunshine, don't forget sunscreen!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 17℃，多云有微风，湿度大。体感舒适，小心着凉。
